description: When may the source document be said to STATE a directional relation between two clinical events? Two events quoted near each other are merely co-located and do not prove a relationship. The primary route requires the endpoints' verified verbatim mentions to sit on either side of a configured linking phrase in one clause. A second, narrowly governed structured-record route applies only to an existing extractor-proposed reason-for edge: both endpoint quotations must be independently reconciled, occupy explicitly labelled diagnosis and procedure fields, and the proposed diagnosis must be the uniquely best governed-axis match for that service among the structured diagnoses. This grammar contains no medical code, code family, clinical term, or specialty-specific procedure.
authority: CMS Program Integrity Manual (Pub. 100-08) Chapter 3, Section 3.3.2.1.1 -- the medical record itself must support the medical necessity of the service billed

ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, Section IV -- report the diagnosis the record documents as the reason for the encounter/service; a linkage the record does not state may not be inferred
CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual (Pub. 100-04) Chapter 23 -- diagnosis-to-service linkage reported on the claim

structured_reason_for.description: A surgical record may state diagnoses and performed services in separate, explicitly labelled fields. This route proves only an extractor-proposed diagnosis-to-service pair whose endpoint quotations were independently reconciled to the original document, whose diagnosis is in a pre/post-operative diagnosis or assessment section, whose service is in a labelled procedure section, and whose diagnosis is the uniquely best governed-axis match for that service among structured diagnoses. It never infers a pair from co-location, encounter membership, model agreement, or an unlabelled narrative section.

reason_for.description: subject (the documented reason) --REASON_FOR--> object (the service performed).

notes: min_independent_assertions affects only the audit/confidence corroboration axis and never release. Agreement between extraction runs is not a statement about the record. Cue phrases, clause boundaries, heading patterns, and compatibility axes are reviewed configuration. A predicate with no entry cannot be reconciled directionally. The structured route never invents a relation: it can only ground an asserted reason-for edge after deterministic source and compatibility checks. Missing reconciliation, missing axes, ambiguous terminology, multiple summary services, or unmatched headings leave the edge unreconciled.
